lessons.title: Where is the... ?

items.example: Wo ist der Bahnhof?
Die Geschäfte sind überall.
Gehen Sie links.
Die Schule ist rechts.
items.exampleMeaning: The school is on the right.

items.example: Gehen Sie geradeaus.
Der Park ist in der Nähe.

lessons.tip: Use 'Wo ist...' to ask for locations. Remember to use the correct article for places, like 'der' for masculine nouns.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, where is the train station?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The train station is straight ahead.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Danke! Ist er in der Nähe?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you! Is it nearby?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, er ist in der Nähe.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is nearby.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Soll ich links oder rechts gehen?
dialogue.meaning: Should I go left or right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Go right.

scenario.partnerRole: a local person who knows the area
scenario.brief: You want to find the train station. Ask where it is and if it's nearby. The local will help you with directions.
scenario.goal: You will learn how to ask for directions to a place.

lessons.title: Giving Directions

items.example: Gehen Sie nach links.
Biegen Sie an der Ecke ab.
An der Kreuzung gehen Sie geradeaus.
items.exampleMeaning: At the intersection, go straight ahead.

items.example: Halt hier!
Die Bank ist gegenüber der Schule.
items.exampleMeaning: The bank is opposite the school.

items.example: Gehen Sie vorbei an dem Restaurant.

lessons.tip: Use the imperative form to give directions. It's direct and clear, like 'Gehen Sie...' or 'Biegen Sie ab...'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How do I get to the bank?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gehen Sie geradeaus und biegen Sie an der Kreuzung ab.
dialogue.meaning: Go straight ahead and turn at the intersection.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ist die Bank gegenüber der Schule?
dialogue.meaning: Is the bank opposite the school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, exactly!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for your help!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: You're welcome!

scenario.learnerRole: a tourist asking for directions to the bank
scenario.brief: You need to find the bank. Ask how to get there and confirm the directions given. The local will guide you.
scenario.goal: You will practice giving and understanding directions.

lessons.title: Places in the City

items.example: Das Restaurant ist teuer.
Der Supermarkt hat frisches Gemüse.
Der Park ist schön im Sommer.
items.exampleMeaning: The park is nice in summer.

items.example: Die Schule ist groß.
Das Kino zeigt einen neuen Film.
items.exampleMeaning: The cinema is showing a new movie.

items.example: Die Apotheke hat Medikamente.

lessons.tip: Remember the articles: 'der' for masculine, 'die' for feminine, and 'das' for neuter nouns. It helps to know the gender of places.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Das Restaurant ist neben dem Supermarkt.
dialogue.meaning: The restaurant is next to the supermarket.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And where is the park?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Der Park ist hinter der Schule.
dialogue.meaning: The park is behind the school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am going to the cinema.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The cinema is far away.

scenario.partnerRole: a local person who knows the city
scenario.brief: You want to know where different places are in the city. Ask about the restaurant, park, cinema, and other locations.
scenario.goal: You will learn to ask about and identify places in the city.

lessons.title: Position Words

items.example: Die Apotheke ist neben dem Restaurant.
items.exampleMeaning: The pharmacy is next to the restaurant.

items.example: Die Schule ist hinter dem Park.
items.exampleMeaning: The school is behind the park.

items.example: Das Kino ist vor dem Supermarkt.
items.exampleMeaning: The cinema is in front of the supermarket.

items.example: Die Bank ist zwischen der Schule und dem Park.
items.exampleMeaning: The bank is between the school and the park.

items.example: Der Himmel ist über uns.
Der Tisch ist unter dem Fenster.
items.exampleMeaning: The table is under the window.

lessons.tip: Use position words to describe where things are. They help you give clearer directions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the pharmacy?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Die Apotheke ist neben dem Restaurant.
dialogue.meaning: The pharmacy is next to the restaurant.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Die Schule ist hinter dem Park.
dialogue.meaning: The school is behind the park.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where is the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Das Kino ist vor dem Supermarkt.
dialogue.meaning: The cinema is in front of the supermarket.

scenario.learnerRole: a tourist asking about the position of places
scenario.brief: You want to find the pharmacy, school, and cinema. Ask where they are and their positions relative to other places.
scenario.goal: You will practice using position words to describe locations.
